task_prompt: Pour liquid from the cup into the small clear container.

properties: Open vessel that can retain and pour liquid.
The right hand tilts its rim above the receiving opening.
The cup itself remains a rigid object.
objects.evidence: Right hand holds and tilts the white cup throughout 0-11 s.

objects.name: small transparent container
properties: Small open container held by the left hand.
Liquid must remain inside rather than only pass near its opening.
objects.evidence: Left hand holds the transparent receiver below the source cup at 0-11 s.
